children.characters:
Our design incorporates 4pt & 8pt spacing to ensure that there is a consistent and visually balanced distance between various elements, such as text, images, buttons, and other interface components. By utilising 4pt & 8pt spacing, we have aimed to create a harmonious and user-friendly design that is easy to navigate and aesthetically pleasing.
We have incorporated a 4pt & 8pt radius into the design. This refers to the rounded corners of elements such as buttons, cards, or images that have been designed with a 4pt & 8pt curvature.
